jobs.title: Senior Federal Account Manager - Department of War
jobs.description:
Open new doors across the federal government and turn real mission needs into opportunities for MatrixSpace’s radar and sensing technology.

MatrixSpace develops AI-enabled radar and sensing systems that help people understand what's happening in the world around them. By combining advanced radar, edge computing, and AI, we deliver situational awareness in environments where traditional sensing solutions struggle.

We’re looking for a Senior Federal Account Manager to grow our business with the US Department of War. You’ll find and develop new opportunities, build lasting customer relationships, and lead deals from first conversation through contract award and expansion. Our sales team is lean, with no dedicated sales support function. You’ll need to be comfortable building your own pipeline, keeping opportunities moving, and handling the details along the way.

If you’re proactive, resourceful, and energized by opening new doors, we’d love to talk.

What You’ll Do

  • Create and execute a sales plan for federal agencies within the Department of War. Find new customers, missions, and applications for our technology.

  • Build relationships with agency leaders, program managers, acquisition teams, technical stakeholders, and end users. Learn what they need and where MatrixSpace can help.

  • Own you
